scaleRule.notes: Footprint width means the shorter side of the oriented footprint rectangle. Height includes roof. Height tags override levels; missing levels use explicitly assumed two stories. This is the authoritative scale rule for rebuilt assets; legacy regions require real-height metadata before migration.
